description: Compound growth / savings calculator: future value of a principal plus monthly contributions at any compounding frequency (incl. continuous), contributions at start or end of month, inflation-adjusted value, APR <-> APY conversion, doubling time, months to reach a target and a yearly breakdown. Works for savings, staking yields and DCA projections. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/compound-interest

annualRatePct.description: Nominal annual rate (APR) in percent; or give apyPct

apyPct.description: Effective annual yield in percent (converted to the APR for the compounding)

inflationPct.description: Annual inflation for the real (today's money) value

target.description: Optional goal amount: months needed to reach it
